description: Na₂LiMnCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.89 Å. Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.06 Å) and two longer (2.09 Å) Li-O bond lengths. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.43 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.31 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-54°. There is one shorter (1.55 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one C atom to form edge-sharing ONa₂LiC trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂MnP tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom.
